name: frihet
title: Frihet ERP
description: Search invoices, clients, products, and review your daily operational business brief in Frihet ERP directly from the keyboard.
author: viktor_berthelius

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Frihet API Key
preferences.description: Your Frihet API key (starts with fri_). Generate a scoped key in Frihet -> Settings -> API Keys.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Canonical Frihet v1 REST endpoint (leave default unless testing against a staging environment).

commands.name: business-brief
commands.title: Business Brief
commands.subtitle: Frihet ERP
commands.description: Daily operational brief: what to review today in your business and why, with explicit coverage and draft vs issued separation.

commands.name: search-invoices
commands.title: Search Invoices
commands.subtitle: Frihet ERP
commands.description: Search and filter invoices by status, inspect line items and tax breakdown, copy invoice numbers, or open in Frihet.

commands.name: search-clients
commands.title: Search Clients
commands.subtitle: Frihet ERP
commands.description: Search clients, inspect contact details and recent CRM activities, copy email or tax ID, and open in Frihet.

commands.name: search-products
commands.title: Search Products
commands.subtitle: Frihet ERP
commands.description: Search catalogue products and services, filter by active status with legacy fallback, and inspect pricing and tax rates.

commands.name: switch-workspace
commands.title: Switch Workspace & Clear Cache
commands.subtitle: Frihet ERP
commands.description: Inspect the connected Frihet workspace, verify tenant cache isolation, purge cached records, or switch API credentials.
